fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole pontoon boat.
findings: Green algae growth along the rear deck edge and corner skirting near the outboard
Dull, chalky-looking aluminum pontoon tubes, especially the rear tubes with grime below the deck
Faded, worn-looking green carpet on the bow and stern decks
Light grime and staining on the lower white side panels near the stern
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Premier pontoon. The new upholstery and Mercury look great, but there's some green algae along the rear deck edge and the tubes look dull and grimy at the stern. We do pre-sale details that come to you, including cleaning the deck, panels and pontoon tubes. Would you like a quote?
